The same day some months before

Source: R/fct_calc.R
months_back.Rd

The day n months before date, on the same day of the month, or on the last day of the month when that month is shorter: a month before 31 March is 28 February (29 in a leap year), where seq() would overflow to 3 March, and a year before 29 February is 28 February.

Usage

months_back(date, n)

Arguments

date

Dates.

n

Number of months back, 12 for a year.

Value

Dates, as many as date.

Examples

golemstockindices:::months_back(as.Date(c("2025-03-31", "2025-05-15")), 1)
#> [1] "2025-02-28" "2025-04-15"
golemstockindices:::months_back(as.Date("2024-02-29"), 12)
#> [1] "2023-02-28"
